description: Create or change a live fact: a short current claim (a price, version, limit or count) that post bodies show inline as {{fact:name}}. Every post that uses it is re-rendered with the new value. Use facts only for things that should stay current. Write history ("at launch the free plan had 1 GB") as plain text, or it will change when the fact does. Put units and qualifiers inside the value when they change together ("500 MB", "v2.4.1"): the words around a fact never update. `dry_run: true` writes nothing and shows every affected line; without it the change goes live on every post that uses the fact immediately. Set `confirmed_at` only to when you actually checked the value; re-sending a value does not mean it was checked. Facts can't go in headings, links, titles or excerpts. A fact used by any post can't be deleted until those posts stop using it.

blog_id.description: Your blog's id, as returned by signup. Optional with an API key: it defaults to the key's blog, and any id you pass must be that blog. Required when the server runs without API keys.

confirmed_at.description: When you actually checked the value: an ISO 8601 date ("2026-10-21") or date-time with a time zone ("2026-10-21T09:30:00Z"). Not in the future, not before 2000. Defaults to now, so only omit it when you checked just now.

dry_run.description: true writes nothing and returns every post and line the change would affect. Without it the change goes live on every post that uses the fact immediately.

expected_value.description: Compare-and-set: the value you believe is current (null: you believe the fact does not exist yet). If it differs, nothing changes and the call fails with FACT_CONFLICT carrying the current value.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key, any unique string (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key and identical arguments returns the first result instead of writing again; the same key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Scoped to your API key and this tool.

name.description: Fact name: a lowercase letter, then up to 39 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, e.g. "pro_price". Post bodies use it as {{fact:pro_price}}.

note.description: Private note on where the value comes from, up to 200 characters. Not shown on pages. null clears it; omitted keeps it.

source_url.description: https URL the value was checked against. Not shown on pages. null clears it; omitted keeps it.

value.description: The current value, as plain text: 1–120 characters, one line, none of [ ] < > * _ ~ ` | \ { }. Put units and qualifiers inside it when they change together, e.g. "500 MB" or "v2.4.1".

name: set_fact

affected_posts.description: Every post that uses the fact. Drafts are listed but not rendered.

lines.description: Each source line that uses the fact, before and after the change.

changed.description: true when the value is new or different; false when only confirmed_at or the note moved.

error.description: Present only on failure (isError: true). Success fields are absent then.

details.description: Extra context. Keys depend on the code.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

fact.description: The fact as it is now (or would be, on a dry run).

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601. When the publisher last checked the value; a post shows the oldest of its facts' dates.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601. When the value last changed; it is the modified time of posts that use it.

used_by.description: Every post whose body uses the fact, drafts included.

rerendered.description: Published posts re-rendered by this call.

title: Set live fact
